The Four Emperors are four pirate captains considered to be the most notorious and powerful in the world.

Historically, the Emperors have dominated the second half of the Grand Line (the "New World"), captaining powerful subordinates and massive fleets while exerting influence and control over dozens of separate pirate crews and even full-fledged nations. As such, the World Government views them collectively as one of the Three Great Powers underpinning world stability. However, no formal system supports them; each Emperor works as an independent force, and may oppose or align with whomever they see fit.

With the rise of the Worst Generation, the Emperors underwent much upheaval, beginning with Marshall "Blackbeard" D. Teach's murder of Emperor Edward "Whitebeard" Newgate during the Summit War of Marineford and usurpation of his position. Two years after the war, then-Emperors Kaidou and Charlotte "Big Mom" Linlin formed an unprecedented two-Emperor alliance, only to be toppled by the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance in the Raid on Onigashima. Straw Hat Luffy, captain of the Straw Hat Pirates and one of the Alliance's leaders, was declared one of the two new Emperiors for defeating Kaidou in combat. The other new Emperor being Buggy the Star Clown, for his unwitting "leadership" of the infamous Cross Guild.
